_comment: wave 37: PROOF of the CONSTANT (non-field) argument capability for windowed aggregations. temporal_simplify_min_dist(const Temporal* temp, double dist) -> Temporal* takes the windowed continuous trajectory PLUS one double constant (the minimum-distance simplification tolerance) and returns the simplified Temporal*, emitted as hex-WKB (VARSIZED). Uses the new fold 'tgeotransform' which routes to the const-args tgeo logical/physical/glue variants: the constant travels as a literal STRING from the parser constantBuilder -> logical constArgs -> serde FunctionList(TEMPORAL_SEQUENCE_CONST_ARGS_KEY)+proto literals -> physical ctor, and is parsed to a C double (atof) only inside the plain-C finalize lambda, which then calls temporal_simplify_min_dist(temp, c0). SQL: TEMPORAL_SIMPLIFY_MIN_DIST(lon, lat, ts, 5.0). The const_args parse switch supports double/int/bool/interval/timestamptz/interptype/set for later waves; only double is exercised here.

operators.comment_one_liner: temporal_simplify_min_dist (Temporal* -> hex-WKB) - the windowed trajectory simplified to a minimum-distance tolerance (double constant arg).
